texto: **Du musst heute nicht arbeiten** means that today you have no obligation to work, you are free to rest if you want. There is no ban.
**Du darfst hier nicht rauchen** means that smoking is completely prohibited by law or by law, and is punishable.

filas: You can come if you want, but it's not mandatory.
not being able, not being possible
I don't have a physical chance of going.

frases.de: Musst du heute früh aufstehen, Jonas?
frases.en: Do you have to get up early today, Jonas?

frases.de: Nein, heute ist Samstag! Ich muss heute nicht arbeiten.
frases.es: ¡No, hoy es sábado! Hoy no tengo que trabajar.
frases.en: No, today is Saturday! I don't have to work today.
analisis: I don't have to work today.

frases.de: Super! Dann können wir im Park Fußball spielen.
frases.es: ¡Genial! Entonces podemos jugar al fútbol en el parque.
frases.en: Great! Then we can play football in the park.
analisis: können wir im Park Fußball spielen
We can play football in the park.

frases.de: Aber Vorsicht: Auf dem Rasen darf man nicht spielen!
frases.es: Pero cuidado: ¡en el césped no se puede jugar!
frases.en: But be careful: on the lawn you can't play!

bloques.pregunta: What does the «Du musst die Rechnung heute nicht bezahlen» phrase mean?

opciones.texto: It's not mandatory to pay today, you can do it later.
opciones.explicacion: «Nicht müssen» indicates lack of need or obligation.

opciones.texto: It's forbidden to pay the bill today.
You don't have enough money to pay the bill.
opciones.explicacion: It does not express a lack of economic capacity.

bloques.pregunta: What prayer would you choose to warn «It's forbidden to park here!»?

opciones.explicacion: It would mean «No need to park here.», which does not prohibit anything.
It means «You don't want to park here.».

bloques.pregunta: you don't have to be unobligated.
bloques.frase: Heute ist Sonntag. Du ___ heute nicht früh aufstehen.

opciones.explicacion: «du musst nicht» states that it is not necessary to early on Sunday.
«du darfst nicht» would absurdly ban early rise.
«du kannst nicht» would express physical disability.

bloques.frase: Hier ist eine Schule. Man ___ hier nicht schnell fahren!

opciones.explicacion: «man darf nicht» indicates the legal prohibition of high-speed circular.
«man muss nicht» would just say it's not mandatory to run.
«man will nicht» would speak of self-will.

opciones.texto: You don't have to work today.
opciones.explicacion: musst nicht = you don't have to / don't need to; heute = today; arbeiten = work.

opciones.texto: You're not allowed to work today.
You have to work for a lot of hours today.
opciones.explicacion: Feeling opposite to the original text.

bloques.frase: Hier ___ man keine Fotos machen. Es ist nicht erlaubt.

opciones.explicacion: «darf man nicht» expresses prohibition, reinforced by «es ist verboten».
«muss man nicht» would simply indicate that it is not mandatory to take photos.
«kann» does not make a policy ban.

bloques.traduccion: You don't have to work today.

intro: In German there is a fundamental difference between **nicht müssen** (not necessary / not necessary) and **nicht dürfen** (strictly prohibited). Confusion completely changes the message.
